newsitem.title: USA: Keystone shrs leap after Tyco offer.
newsitem.headline: Keystone shrs leap after Tyco offer.

text.p: Tyco International Inc's agreement to acquire Keystone International Inc for about $1.2 billion in stock lifted Keystone stock almost 55 percent Wednesday in unusually heavy trade, traders said.

By midday, Keystone shares were up 10-3/4 to 31-1/4, off the earlier session high of 32-5/8. Volume on the NYSE was more than 1.3 million shares, exceeding the stock's daily average daily of about 86,000 shares traded.
Keystone's previous year-high stock price was 22-1/8.
The companies said overnight Keystone holders will get 0.54183 Tyco shares for each Keystone share, subject to adjustment based on the trading value of Tyco stock.
Based on Tyco's Tuesday closing price of $62.75, the terms valued Keystone, a maker of valves and other flow-control equipment, at $34 per share.
Meanwhile, Tyco shares were off 1-1/8 to 61-5/8, putting the value of Keystone's shares in the deal at about $33.40.
The acquisition is the latest in a string of large takeovers announced by Tyco, a diversified manufacturer of industrial and commercial products.
"There is some concern that at some point does their resources become stretched management-wise," said an arbitrageur who declined to be named.

"But so far so good. They have distinct (operating) divisions. They are a modern-day conglomerate. The price (for Keystone) is a big premium, but maybe they (Tyco) had to be pre-emptive," the arb said.
Last week, Tyco announced the $320 million stock acquistion of INBRAND Corp, a maker of disposable adult incontinence products.
Tyco also has agreed to pay $850 million for AT&T Corp's submarine systems business, a deal announced April 11.
Two months ago, Tyco said it would acquire ADT Ltd in a stock transaction then valued at $29 per ADT share, or $5.6 billion.
The friendly Tyco/ADT merger came after ADT rejected a $3.5 billion hostile bid from Western Resources Inc.
Western, a Kansas-based electric and gas utility company, owns 27 percent of ADT.
